description: WonderKit helps friends, couples and families plan trips together. Ask what to do in a city and WonderKit returns curated, venue-verified things to do for families, couples or friends, plus researched day-by-day itineraries and themed place guides, including seasonal trips such as fall foliage road trips in New England, the Hudson Valley and Shenandoah. Every result links to the full guide on wonderkit.app, and you can hand off to the WonderKit planner to build a custom trip with your group. The app is read-only: it never creates, changes or deletes anything, needs no account, and cannot see anyone's private trips.
